Header.title: Reza Salehi
Header.paragraph: Full-stack specialist with a strong frontend focus, building polished web and app experiences.

About.paragraph: Self-taught web and mobile programmer with {{years}} years of professional experience in more than ten projects. Strong skills in teamwork, communication, creativity, and meeting timelines. Passionate about learning and seeking new opportunities in the field
Why: 2+ years React, freelancer and team worker
2+ years Nextjs, Vue, Nuxt, Angular Developer, Working with ssg/isr, next/image, ...
Master in creating mobile-first and responsive websites
Master in creating fully customized html/css component
Master in ui library like material ui and emotion
Experience working with RestFull and Graphql
